name: CI

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
      - 'epic/**'

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ******

jobs:
  release-version-integrity:
    name: Release version integrity
    if: >-
      github.event_name == 'pull_request' &&
      github.actor == 'github-actions[bot]' &&
      github.event.pull_request.user.login == 'github-actions[bot]' &&
      github.event.pull_request.base.ref == github.event.repository.default_branch &&
      github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository &&
      startsWith(github.event.pull_request.head.ref, 'release/v')
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 5
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read

    steps:
      - name: Check out trusted release validation
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
          sparse-checkout: |-
            scripts/validate-release-pr.mts
            scripts/release-github-evidence.mts
          sparse-checkout-cone-mode: false

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: 24
          package-manager-cache: false

      - name: Validate version-only release change
        env:
          GITHUB_DEFAULT_BRANCH: ${{ github.event.repository.default_branch }}
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          RELEASE_PR_HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          RELEASE_PR_MODE: pre-merge
          RELEASE_PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
          RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
        run: node scripts/validate-release-pr.mts

  verify:
    name: Verification (Linux)
    needs: release-version-integrity
    if: always() && needs.release-version-integrity.result == 'skipped'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 15
    permissions:
      actions: read
      contents: read
      issues: read
      pull-requests: read

    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          # Architecture validates the exact event base/head and accepted epic history.
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: 24
          package-manager-cache: false

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run policy, type, and test verification
        env:
          HVIR_REPO_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: npm run verify

  electron-smoke:
    name: Electron smoke (Linux)
    needs: release-version-integrity
    if: always() && needs.release-version-integrity.result == 'skipped'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 15

    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: 24
          package-manager-cache: false

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run production Electron workflow
        env:
          HVIR_SMOKE_ARTIFACT_DIR: ${{ runner.temp }}/hvir-smoke-artifacts/production
        run: xvfb-run -a npm run smoke

      - name: Run development renderer Performance Timeline containment
        env:
          HVIR_SMOKE_ARTIFACT_DIR: ${{ runner.temp }}/hvir-smoke-artifacts/development-performance
        run: xvfb-run -a npm run smoke:development-performance

      - name: Prove failure and interruption isolation
        run: xvfb-run -a npm run smoke:isolation

      - name: Upload bounded Electron failure evidence
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: ci-electron-smoke-failure-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/hvir-smoke-artifacts
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          retention-days: 7

  macos-electron-smoke:
    # Temporary reduced gate: terminal-presentation, terminal-lifecycle, and capacity
    # remain available through local commands while their macOS flakes are hardened.
    name: Electron correctness (macOS arm64; temporary reduced gate)
    needs: release-version-integrity
    if: always() && needs.release-version-integrity.result == 'skipped'
    runs-on: macos-15
    timeout-minutes: 15

    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: 24
          package-manager-cache: false

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run focused unpackaged Electron scenarios
        env:
          HVIR_SMOKE_ARTIFACT_DIR: ${{ runner.temp }}/hvir-smoke-artifacts/macos-ci
        run: npm run smoke:macos:ci

      - name: Upload bounded macOS Electron failure evidence
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: ci-macos-electron-smoke-failure-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/hvir-smoke-artifacts
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          retention-days: 7

  codeql:
    name: CodeQL analysis
    needs: release-version-integrity
    if: always() && needs.release-version-integrity.result == 'skipped'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 20
    permissions:
      actions: read
      contents: read
      packages: read
      security-events: write

    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Initialize CodeQL
        uses: github/codeql-action/init@v4.37.9
        with:
          languages: javascript-typescript

      - name: Analyze
        uses: github/codeql-action/analyze@v4.37.9

  merge-acceptance:
    name: Merge acceptance
    needs:
      - release-version-integrity
      - verify
      - electron-smoke
      - macos-electron-smoke
      - codeql
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 5
    permissions:
      actions: read
      contents: read

    steps:
      - name: Check out exact head for base ancestry proof
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Require one coherent CI attempt
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: node scripts/ci-attempt-evidence.mts

      - name: Require exact candidate ancestry
        env:
          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
        run: |
          if [[ ! "$BASE_SHA" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ || ! "$HEAD_SHA" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]; then
            echo "::error::Pull request base and head must be full commit SHAs"
            exit 1
          fi
          if [ "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" != "$HEAD_SHA" ]; then
            echo "::error::Merge acceptance did not check out the exact pull request head"
            exit 1
          fi
          if ! git merge-base --is-ancestor "$BASE_SHA" "$HEAD_SHA"; then
            echo "::error::The tested pull request base is not an ancestor of its head"
            exit 1
          fi

name: Release

  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      bump:
        description: current releases package.json; patch/minor/major open a validated release PR.
        required: ******

        options:
          - current
          - patch
          - minor
          - major

        description: Exact merged release source; automation only, normally left blank.

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: release
  cancel-in-progress: false

  prepare:
    name: Prepare ${{ inputs.bump }} release

    timeout-minutes: 15

      actions: read
      contents: write
      issues: read
      pull-requests: write

          if [ "$GITHUB_REF" != "refs/heads/$DEFAULT_BRANCH" ]; then
            echo "::error::Run releases from $DEFAULT_BRANCH, not $GITHUB_REF_NAME"
            exit 1
          fi

        uses: actions/checkout@v7

          ref: ${{ github.event.repository.default_branch }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          fetch-tags: ******

          DEFAULT_BRANCH: ${{ github.event.repository.default_branch }}

          if [ -z "$SOURCE_SHA" ]; then
            exit 0

          if [[ ! "$SOURCE_SHA" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]; then
            echo "::error::Release source must be a full commit SHA"
            exit 1

            echo "::error::Release source $SOURCE_SHA is not available"
            exit 1

            exit 1

          echo "tag=$tag" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "sha=$(git rev-parse HEAD)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}

          RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA: ${{ steps.version.outputs.sha }}

            echo "ready=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

            echo "sha=$RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "Release source: $RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

            artifact_name: release-linux-x64
            deb_arch: amd64
            release_arch: x64
          - name: Ubuntu 24.04 arm64

# hvir

hvir is a TypeScript/Electron desktop workbench for software projects. It combines local and SSH workspace access, terminal sessions, file viewing, Git workflows, and session/diagnostic tooling in a single app.

## Highlights

- **Workspace-aware project navigation** across local and remote (`ssh:`) hosts
- **Integrated terminal runtime** (Ghostty Web + `node-pty`) with persistent sessions
- **File tree + split viewer workflows** for source exploration and editing
- **Git tooling** for status/history, graph views, branch switching, fetch, and pull
- **Web/document surfaces** including HTML/Markdown-oriented presentation paths
- **Runtime diagnostics** with health reporting and bounded recovery flows

- Electron 43 + electron-vite
- React 19
- TypeScript 6
- Vitest, ESLint, Prettier
- Native Node-API addon: `@hvir/rename-noreplace` (Darwin/Linux)

- **Node.js 24+** (required by `package.json` engines)
- **npm** (uses `package-lock.json` and `npm` scripts)
- **macOS or Linux** (native addon and packaging targets are Darwin/Linux)
- Native build prerequisites for `node-gyp` dependencies:
  - macOS: Xcode Command Line Tools
  - Linux: compiler toolchain (`gcc`/`clang`), `make`, and Python 3

```bash
npm ci
npm run dev
```

Open a specific workspace at startup:

```bash
npm run dev -- --project-root=/absolute/path/to/repo
# or
HVIR_PROJECT_ROOT=/absolute/path/to/repo npm run dev
```

If terminal runtime validation reports a dependency mismatch, refresh dependencies with:

```bash
npm ci
```

|---|---|

| Command | Artifact target |
|---|---|

| `npm run pack:mac:arm64:signed` | macOS ARM64 signed `.pkg` |
| `npm run pack:linux:x64` | Linux x64 `.deb` |
| `npm run pack:linux:arm64` | Linux ARM64 `.deb` |
| `npm run assemble:native-release` | Assemble release artifacts from native package outputs |

## Optional Git hooks

Install local repository hooks:

```bash
npm run hooks:install
```

The included pre-push hook runs TypeScript checks and local-platform smoke coverage.

```text
src/main        Electron main-process runtime and IPC authority
src/preload     Typed preload bridge (window.hvir)
src/renderer    React UI and renderer feature surfaces
src/shared      Shared contracts/types across process boundaries
src/workers     Utility-process workers (echo/git)
scripts         Automation for checks, smoke, release, and project tooling
test            Vitest suites and fixtures
packages/       Native package(s), including rename-noreplace
```

## License

MIT (`LICENSE`). Third-party notices: `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`.
